## Decisions and review

Skill-orchestrator-pro/skill-router routed planning, Supabase, TDD and verification. Council-review was a proportional **single-assistant simulated review**, not independent reviewers or agents: newcomer/accessibility lens favored equal static guidance and optional tours; security/skeptical lens favored typed independently reauthorized targets and no byte previews; maintenance lens favored immutable publications and permanent aliases. Rich embeds/arbitrary URLs were the credible alternative, rejected for this bounded slice because they add unnecessary content-fetch/access paths. Core text-safety acknowledgment cannot detect copied restricted prose; approved institutional content/privacy review remains an explicit gate. Fixed resource scope prevents silent expansion through a draft. No new authority was invented for live use.

Manual code/security review checked actor derivation, execute revocations/search paths, forced RLS/raw denial, old/new scope, draft isolation, immutable aliases/history, form ID stability, target reauthorization and retry/rollback. No agents/chats/worktrees were used.
